title_en: Exclusive, super apartment for sale 2+1+2 toilets+parking post in Ali Dem
description_en: Exclusive, super apartment for sale 2+1+2 toilets+parking post in Ali Dem of "Mangalem Complex". The apartment is located on the 6th and last floor of a new building with an elevator with only 2 apartments per floor, it has a net area of 101 m², gross 125 m² and is invested in details by an architect with considerable investment where it is worth mentioning: Engineered parquet, comfortable sofa received by order from "Vip Saloti", ceiling works, custom Italian furniture, wardrobe, hydro-sanitary, electrical works and new windows and doors. This apartment has all the necessary conditions for a comfortable life. Price including parking post 250,000 euros
